What was the average real-time five-minute LMP at ERCOT_BUS_A on October 21, 2026, in USD/MWh? Use the electrical bus, not the trading hub.
How much gross battery discharge energy in MWh was observed in CAISO on October 21, 2026, using five-minute storage dispatch?
How much gross battery discharge energy in MWh did MISO deliver on October 17, 2026 local time? Use five-minute storage dispatch.
What was ERCOT's actual hourly demand in MW at exactly October 21, 2026 00:00 UTC? Use UTC, not the local calendar date.
How many MW of nuclear resource capacity were unavailable due to forced outages in NYISO on October 19, 2026? Exclude planned outages.
What was PJM's average regulation-up ancillary service clearing price on October 18, 2026 local time, in USD/MW-hour? Do not use energy LMPs or other reserve products.

In California's current interconnection queue, what percentage of active solar capacity in MW belongs to solar projects paired with storage? Weight by proposed capacity, not project count; use the is_hybrid flag and include all active solar capacity in the denominator.

What was New England's largest positive hour-to-hour change in actual hourly demand on October 19, 2026 local time, in MW? Compare only consecutive readings whose two hours are both on that local date; use UTC ordering.
What percentage of PJM's generation came from natural gas in September 2026?
For CAISO_HUB on October 21, 2026 from 5 pm to 6 pm local, what was average real-time hub LMP minus day-ahead hourly hub LMP? Report the signed spread in USD/MWh.
What was ERCOT's latest hourly load forecast available at or before October 20, 2026 18:00 UTC for delivery on October 21 at 5 pm local? Report forecast MW.
For SPP delivery at 14:00 local on October 19, 2026, what was the latest load forecast in MW published by October 18, 2026 18:00 UTC?
At ISONE_HUB on October 16, 2026 from noon to 1 pm local, what was mean five-minute real-time hub LMP minus day-ahead hourly hub LMP? Give the signed spread in USD/MWh.
For CAISO delivery at October 21, 2026 15:00 UTC, what was the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 09:00 UTC? Include a publication exactly at the cutoff. Report MW.
What was CAISO's net battery energy output in MWh on October 21, 2026 local time? Integrate discharge minus charging, using five-minute dispatch, rather than reporting gross discharge.
How much wind energy was curtailed in SPP on October 20, 2026 local time, in MWh? Integrate five-minute curtailed power, not generated output.

For CAISO on October 21, 2026 local time, find the hour with the highest signed real-time minus day-ahead hub LMP spread. Average the 12 five-minute real-time hub LMPs within each hour before subtracting that hour's day-ahead hub LMP; negative spreads are allowed. Break ties by the earliest UTC hour. For the winning hour, using the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 12:00 UTC, what is forecast MW minus actual hourly demand MW? Report the signed error in MW.

For California on October 21, 2026 local time, select the three hours with the highest actual hourly demand, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. During those hours only, what was the battery fleet's net energy revenue in USD at CAISO_HUB real-time LMPs? Value discharge positively and charging negatively at the matching five-minute hub price. Rank hourly demand first, then align storage and prices by ISO and UTC interval and convert interval MW to MWh before summing. Ignore fees and efficiency losses.

For ERCOT's delivery hours on October 19, 2026 local time, calculate mean absolute load-forecast error in MW using only information published at or before October 19, 2026 00:00 UTC. For each delivery hour choose the latest eligible forecast, then compare with actual hourly demand. Exclude any hour without an eligible forecast; do not average forecast vintages or use the simple demand_forecast_mw field.

For SPP on October 20, 2026 local time, what percentage of available wind energy was curtailed? Define available energy as hourly observed wind-generation energy plus five-minute curtailed wind energy. Convert each series to MWh at its own cadence, aggregate separately, and report 100 times curtailed divided by available.

For California and Texas separately, find each region's highest actual hourly demand on October 19, 2026 local time, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. At each winning hour calculate wind plus solar generation as a percentage of total net generation across all fuels. Aggregate fuel rows before joining the hourly balance. Report California's percentage minus Texas's percentage in percentage points.

For ERCOT on October 18, 2026 local time, find the hour of highest actual hourly demand minus hourly wind and solar generation. Aggregate the two fuels before joining demand, and break ties by earliest UTC hour. For that winning hour, report average five-minute real-time HUB LMP minus matching day-ahead HUB LMP, in USD/MWh. Use hourly generation and demand, not five-minute load or generation.

Compare the mean energy-price component (energy, not total LMP) for real-time bus, real-time hub and day-ahead hub series across all seven ISOs for October 15–21, 2026, inclusive in each ISO's local time. Average all native-interval observations for each ISO/product; for bus series pool the three buses with equal observation weights. Return all 21 combinations as columns iso_code, product, average_energy_price in USD/MWh. Use product labels real_time_bus, real_time_hub, and day_ahead_hub; do not omit a region or product or substitute a missing-series claim.

WITH rt AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.lmp) AS mean_rt_lmp
  FROM core.isone_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id = l.location_id
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON r.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
    AND l.location_code = 'ISONE_HUB'
    AND r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00'
    AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 13:00:00'
), da AS (
  SELECT AVG(d.lmp) AS da_lmp
  FROM core.isone_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON d.location_id = l.location_id
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON d.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
    AND l.location_code = 'ISONE_HUB'
    AND d.interval_start_local = TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00'
)
SELECT rt.mean_rt_lmp - da.da_lmp AS signed_spread_usd_per_mwh
FROM rt CROSS JOIN da;

WITH rt AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.lmp) AS mean_rt_lmp
  FROM core.isone_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id = l.location_id
  WHERE l.location_code = 'ISONE_HUB'
    AND r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00'
    AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 13:00:00'
), da AS (
  SELECT AVG(d.lmp) AS mean_da_lmp
  FROM core.isone_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON d.location_id = l.location_id
  WHERE l.location_code = 'ISONE_HUB'
    AND d.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00'
    AND d.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 13:00:00'
)
SELECT rt.mean_rt_lmp - da.mean_da_lmp AS answer
FROM rt CROSS JOIN da

WITH rt AS (
    SELECT iso_id, location_id,
           date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           AVG(lmp) AS mean_rt_lmp
    FROM core.isone_lmp_rt_hub_5min
    WHERE interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00'
      AND interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 13:00:00'
    GROUP BY iso_id, location_id, date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
), da AS (
    SELECT iso_id, location_id, interval_start_utc AS hour_utc, lmp AS da_lmp
    FROM core.isone_lmp_da_hub_hourly
    WHERE interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00'
      AND interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 13:00:00'
)
SELECT AVG(rt.mean_rt_lmp - da.da_lmp) AS signed_spread_usd_per_mwh
FROM rt
JOIN da USING (iso_id, location_id, hour_utc)
JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = rt.location_id
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = rt.iso_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
  AND l.location_code = 'ISONE_HUB'

WITH h AS (
  SELECT interval_start_utc, interval_start_local, load_mw
  FROM core.fact_load_5min
  WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ISONE')
    AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
), hourly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
         avg(load_mw) AS hourly_demand_mw,
         min(CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE)) AS local_date
  FROM h
  GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
), changes AS (
  SELECT hourly_demand_mw - lag(hourly_demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS change_mw,
         local_date,
         lag(local_date) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS prior_local_date
  FROM hourly
)
SELECT max(change_mw) AS max_positive_hour_to_hour_change_mw
FROM changes
WHERE local_date = DATE '2026-10-19'
  AND prior_local_date = DATE '2026-10-19'
  AND change_mw > 0

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
         avg(load_mw) AS hourly_demand_mw,
         min(CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE)) AS local_date
  FROM core.fact_load_5min
  WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ISONE')
    AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
), changes AS (
  SELECT hour_utc, hourly_demand_mw - lag(hourly_demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS change_mw,
         local_date, lag(local_date) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS prior_local_date
  FROM hourly
)
SELECT max(change_mw) AS max_positive_hour_to_hour_change_mw
FROM changes
WHERE local_date = DATE '2026-10-19' AND prior_local_date = DATE '2026-10-19' AND change_mw > 0

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc,
         b.demand_mw,
         LAG(b.demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY b.interval_start_utc) AS prev_demand_mw,
         CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) AS local_date
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
    AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
)
SELECT MAX(demand_mw - prev_demand_mw) AS largest_positive_change_mw
FROM hourly
WHERE local_date = DATE '2026-10-19'
  AND prev_demand_mw IS NOT NULL
  AND demand_mw - prev_demand_mw > 0

WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local, b.demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
), changes AS (
    SELECT demand_mw - LAG(demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY interval_start_utc) AS change_mw
    FROM hourly
)
SELECT MAX(change_mw) AS largest_positive_hour_to_hour_change_mw
FROM changes
WHERE change_mw > 0

SELECT b.demand_mw AS demand_mw
FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'

SELECT AVG(load_mw) AS actual_hourly_demand_mw

WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ERCOT')
  AND interval_start_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'

SELECT b.demand_mw AS actual_hourly_demand_mw
FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b

WITH wind AS (
    SELECT f.fuel_id
    FROM core.dim_fuel AS f
    WHERE f.fuel_code = 'wind'
),
generated AS (
    SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generation_mwh
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
    JOIN wind AS w ON w.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
      AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
),
curtailed AS (
    SELECT SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) AS curtailed_mwh
    FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min AS c
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = c.iso_id
    JOIN wind AS w ON w.fuel_id = c.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
      AND CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailed.curtailed_mwh /
       (generated.generation_mwh + curtailed.curtailed_mwh) AS percentage_curtailed
FROM generated CROSS JOIN curtailed

WITH gen AS (
    SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generated_mwh
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON g.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
      AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'
      AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), curtailed AS (
    SELECT SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) AS curtailed_mwh
    FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min AS c
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON c.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON c.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
      AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'
      AND CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailed.curtailed_mwh / (gen.generated_mwh + curtailed.curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_pct_of_available
FROM gen CROSS JOIN curtailed

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generated_mwh
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'

  WHERE f.fuel_code = 'wind'

)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailed.curtailed_mwh / (hourly.generated_mwh + curtailed.curtailed_mwh) AS answer
FROM hourly CROSS JOIN curtailed

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(g.generation_mw) / NULLIF(SUM(b.net_generation_mw), 0) AS natural_gas_generation_pct FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON g.iso_id = i.iso_id JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly AS b ON g.iso_id = b.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc WHERE i.iso_code = 'PJM' AND f.fuel_code = 'natural_gas' AND g.interval_start_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND g.interval_start_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'

FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly AS b ON b.iso_id = g.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = g.interval_start_utc

  AND g.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'

WITH gas AS (
  SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS gas_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'PJM'
    AND f.fuel_code = 'natural_gas'
    AND g.interval_start_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND g.interval_start_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'

SELECT 100.0 * gas.gas_mw / total.total_mw AS natural_gas_generation_percentage
FROM gas CROSS JOIN total

        f.forecast_mw,

            PARTITION BY f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc

WITH targets AS (

    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b

    WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
),
winners AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw, net_generation_mw
    FROM daily_balance
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY iso_id
        ORDER BY demand_mw DESC NULLS LAST, interval_start_utc ASC
    ) = 1
),
fuel_totals AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    JOIN winners w ON w.iso_id = g.iso_id AND w.interval_start_utc = g.interval_start_utc
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
),
shares AS (
    SELECT t.iso_code, 100.0 * ft.wind_solar_mw / w.net_generation_mw AS share_pct
    FROM winners w
    JOIN targets t ON t.iso_id = w.iso_id
    JOIN fuel_totals ft ON ft.iso_id = w.iso_id AND ft.interval_start_utc = w.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN share_pct END) AS california_minus_texas_percentage_points
FROM shares

WITH peak AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'

), renewables AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc, SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), at_peaks AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.demand_mw, b.net_generation_mw,
           r.wind_solar_mw,
           100.0 * r.wind_solar_mw / b.net_generation_mw AS renewable_pct
    FROM peak p
    JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b
      ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN renewables r
      ON r.iso_id = p.iso_id AND r.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    WHERE p.rn = 1
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_pct END)

JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = a.iso_id

WITH daily_balance AS (

WITH top_hours AS (

    WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'

  WHERE f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - b.demand_mw AS signed_error_mw
FROM winner AS w
JOIN forecast AS f ON f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc AND f.rn = 1
JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly AS b ON b.iso_id = w.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc

WITH rt_hourly AS (
 SELECT r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc AS hour_utc, r.location_id, AVG(r.lmp) rt_lmp_avg, COUNT(*) n
 FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id=r.iso_id JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id=r.location_id AND l.iso_id=r.iso_id
 WHERE i.iso_code='CAISO' AND l.location_type='hub' AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-21'
 GROUP BY r.iso_id,r.interval_start_utc,r.location_id
), spreads AS (

), winner AS (
 SELECT iso_id,hour_utc FROM spreads WHERE n=12 ORDER BY spread DESC,hour_utc LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rt_hourly) rt_hours,

       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f JOIN winner w ON f.iso_id=w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc=w.hour_utc WHERE f.publish_time_utc<=TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00') forecast_count

WITH rt_hourly AS (
 SELECT r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc AS hour_utc, r.location_id, AVG(r.lmp) rt_lmp_avg, COUNT(*) n
 FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id=r.iso_id JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id=r.location_id AND l.iso_id=r.iso_id
 WHERE i.iso_code='CAISO' AND l.location_type='hub' AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-21'

), spreads AS (

), winner AS (SELECT iso_id,hour_utc FROM spreads ORDER BY spread DESC,hour_utc LIMIT 1), fc AS (

)
SELECT w.hour_utc, (SELECT spread FROM spreads s WHERE s.iso_id=w.iso_id AND s.hour_utc=w.hour_utc) winning_spread_usd_mwh,

WITH rt_hour AS (
    SELECT r.iso_id, r.location_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp, COUNT(*) AS rt_n

    WHERE d.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND d.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
      AND l.location_type = 'hub'
), spreads AS (
    SELECT r.iso_id, r.location_id, r.hour_utc, r.rt_avg_lmp - d.da_lmp AS spread
    FROM rt_hour r JOIN da d USING (iso_id, location_id, hour_utc)
    WHERE r.rt_n = 12
), winner AS (
    SELECT * FROM spreads ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
    SELECT f.interval_start_utc, f.forecast_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) AS rn
    FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f
    WHERE f.iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'CAISO')
      AND f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
), hourly_actual AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc, AVG(load_mw) AS actual_mw, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM core.fact_load_5min
    WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'CAISO')
      AND interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - a.actual_mw AS answer
FROM winner w
JOIN forecast f ON f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc AND f.rn = 1
JOIN hourly_actual a ON a.hour_utc = w.hour_utc
WHERE a.n = 12

WITH rt_hour AS (
    SELECT r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc, l.location_id,
           AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp,
           COUNT(*) AS rt_intervals
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min AS r

    GROUP BY r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc, l.location_id
), hourly AS (
    SELECT rt.iso_id, rt.interval_start_utc, rt.location_id,
           rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp AS spread
    FROM rt_hour AS rt
    JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly AS da
      ON da.iso_id = rt.iso_id
     AND da.interval_start_utc = rt.interval_start_utc

    WHERE rt.rt_intervals = 12
), winner AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, location_id, spread
    FROM hourly

), forecast AS (

    FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly AS f
    JOIN winner AS w ON f.iso_id = w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc = w.interval_start_utc

)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - b.demand_mw AS forecast_minus_actual_mw
FROM winner AS w
JOIN forecast AS f ON f.iso_id = w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc = w.interval_start_utc AND f.rn = 1
JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly AS b ON b.iso_id = w.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = w.interval_start_utc

WITH rt_hour AS (
 SELECT r.iso_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc, r.location_id, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg, COUNT(*) AS n
 FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id=r.location_id
 WHERE r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00' AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' AND l.location_type='hub'
 GROUP BY r.iso_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc), r.location_id
), h AS (
 SELECT rt.iso_id, rt.hour_utc, rt.location_id, rt.rt_avg-da.lmp AS spread, rt.n
 FROM rt_hour rt JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly da ON da.iso_id=rt.iso_id AND da.interval_start_utc=rt.hour_utc AND da.location_id=rt.location_id
 WHERE rt.n=12
), w AS (SELECT iso_id,hour_utc,location_id,spread FROM h ORDER BY spread DESC,hour_utc LIMIT 1), f AS (
 SELECT forecast_mw, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY publish_time_utc DESC) rn FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f JOIN w ON f.iso_id=w.iso_id AND f.interval_start_utc=w.hour_utc WHERE f.publish_time_utc<=TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw-b.demand_mw AS forecast_minus_actual_mw
FROM w JOIN f ON f.rn=1 JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b ON b.iso_id=w.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc=w.hour_utc

WITH iso AS (
    SELECT iso_id, iso_code
    FROM core.dim_iso
    WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
),
peak AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
    WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
      AND b.demand_mw IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY b.iso_id
        ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC
    ) = 1
),
fuel_totals AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw,
           SUM(g.generation_mw) AS all_fuels_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
    JOIN peak p ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT i.iso_code,
           100.0 * ft.wind_solar_mw / NULLIF(ft.all_fuels_mw, 0) AS renewable_pct
    FROM peak p
    JOIN iso i ON p.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN fuel_totals ft ON ft.iso_id = p.iso_id AND ft.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_pct END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN renewable_pct END) AS california_minus_texas_percentage_points
FROM percentages

WITH iso AS (
    SELECT iso_id, iso_code
    FROM core.dim_iso
    WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
),
daily_peak AS (
    SELECT
        b.iso_id,
        b.interval_start_utc,
        b.demand_mw,
        b.net_generation_mw,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.iso_id
            ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
),
wind_solar AS (
    SELECT
        g.iso_id,
        g.interval_start_utc,
        SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
),
peak_share AS (
    SELECT
        i.iso_code,
        100.0 * w.wind_solar_mw / p.net_generation_mw AS renewable_pct
    FROM daily_peak p
    JOIN iso i ON i.iso_id = p.iso_id
    JOIN wind_solar w
      ON w.iso_id = p.iso_id
     AND w.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    WHERE p.rn = 1
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN renewable_pct END) AS answer
FROM peak_share

WITH targets AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw, b.net_generation_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
), ranked AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw, net_generation_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iso_id ORDER BY demand_mw DESC NULLS LAST, interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM targets
), renewable AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), winners AS (
    SELECT r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc, r.net_generation_mw, x.wind_solar_mw
    FROM ranked AS r
    LEFT JOIN renewable AS x
      ON x.iso_id = r.iso_id AND x.interval_start_utc = r.interval_start_utc
    WHERE r.rn = 1
), percentages AS (
    SELECT i.iso_code,
           100.0 * w.wind_solar_mw / NULLIF(w.net_generation_mw, 0) AS renewable_pct
    FROM winners AS w
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = w.iso_id
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN renewable_pct END) AS answer
FROM percentages

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_solar_projects FROM core.queue_project q JOIN core.dim_iso i ON q.iso_id = i.iso_id JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON q.fuel_id = f.fuel_id WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' AND q.status_code = 'active' AND f.fuel_code = 'solar';

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT forecast_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY iso_id, interval_start_utc
           ORDER BY publish_time_utc DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM core.spp_load_forecast_hourly
  WHERE interval_start_local = TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 14:00:00'
    AND publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 18:00:00'
)
SELECT forecast_mw

WITH gen_by_hour AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), demand_net AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw - g.wind_solar_mw AS net_demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    JOIN gen_by_hour AS g ON g.iso_id = b.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
), winning_hour AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc
    FROM demand_net
    ORDER BY net_demand_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1
), rt_hub_by_hour AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc,
           AVG(p.lmp) AS avg_rt_hub_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_rt_hub_5min AS p
    JOIN core.dim_location AS l ON l.location_id = p.location_id
    WHERE l.location_type = 'hub'
    GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT AVG(r.avg_rt_hub_lmp) - AVG(d.lmp) AS answer_usd_per_mwh
FROM winning_hour AS w
JOIN rt_hub_by_hour AS r ON r.iso_id = w.iso_id AND date_trunc('hour', w.interval_start_utc) = date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc)
JOIN core.ercot_lmp_da_hub_hourly AS d ON d.iso_id = w.iso_id AND d.interval_start_utc = date_trunc('hour', w.interval_start_utc)
JOIN core.dim_location AS dl ON dl.location_id = d.location_id AND dl.location_type = 'hub'

WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT b.interval_start_utc,
           b.demand_mw - SUM(g.generation_mw) AS residual_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
      ON g.iso_id = b.iso_id
     AND g.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
      AND f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
    GROUP BY b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw
), winning_hour AS (
    SELECT interval_start_utc
    FROM hourly
    ORDER BY residual_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1
), rt AS (
    SELECT p.interval_start_utc, AVG(p.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_rt_hub_5min p
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = p.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = p.location_id AND l.location_type = 'hub'
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND CAST(p.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
    GROUP BY p.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT AVG(rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp) AS answer_usd_per_mwh
FROM winning_hour w
JOIN rt ON rt.interval_start_utc >= w.interval_start_utc
       AND rt.interval_start_utc < w.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
JOIN core.ercot_lmp_da_hub_hourly da
  ON da.interval_start_utc = w.interval_start_utc
JOIN core.dim_location dl ON dl.location_id = da.location_id AND dl.location_type = 'hub'
WHERE CAST(da.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18';

WITH hourly_fuel AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
      AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), demand AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
), residual AS (
    SELECT d.iso_id, d.interval_start_utc,
           d.demand_mw - f.wind_solar_mw AS residual_mw
    FROM demand AS d
    JOIN hourly_fuel AS f USING (iso_id, interval_start_utc)
    ORDER BY residual_mw DESC, d.interval_start_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1
), rt_hour AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.location_id,
           AVG(p.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_rt_hub_5min AS p
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = p.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND CAST(p.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
    GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.location_id
)
SELECT AVG(r.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp) AS answer_usd_per_mwh
FROM residual AS h
JOIN rt_hour AS r
  ON r.iso_id = h.iso_id
 AND r.interval_start_utc >= h.interval_start_utc
 AND r.interval_start_utc < h.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
JOIN core.ercot_lmp_da_hub_hourly AS da
  ON da.iso_id = r.iso_id
 AND da.interval_start_utc = h.interval_start_utc
 AND da.location_id = r.location_id
JOIN core.dim_location AS loc
  ON loc.location_id = r.location_id
 AND loc.location_type = 'hub'
JOIN core.dim_iso AS di ON di.iso_id = da.iso_id
WHERE CAST(da.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-18'
  AND di.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
